description: This bar chart, titled "Runtime Comparison of Models in Stream...", illustrates the runtime in seconds for different models, comparing "Our Joint Framework" against various "LLM Models". The vertical axis is labeled "Runtime (seconds)" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 400, with major gridlines and tick marks at intervals of 50. The horizontal axis lists the model names: "Work" (with a green bar for "Our Joint Framework" showing a runtime of 77 seconds), "ChatGPT" (a blue bar for "LLM Models" showing 190 seconds), "DeepSeek" (a blue bar for "LLM Models" showing 365 seconds), "LLaMA" (a blue bar for "LLM Models" showing 172 seconds), and "Claude" (a blue bar for "LLM Models" showing 243 seconds). The chart uses a legend to indicate that green bars represent "Our Joint Framework" and blue bars represent "LLM Models". The bars are arranged in the order of the model names on the x-axis and are not sorted. The "Our Joint Framework" bar for "Work" is visually distinct due to its color and significantly shorter height compared to all LLM model bars. All LLM model bars are blue and their exact runtime values are labeled directly on top of each bar.
